messages.text: BL-1668 🎵 in progress — is_qa_ancestor.sh approves a recorded land replay only when its source sits on swarmforge-QA, so a final commit hand-built from the land step's own replay (recorded against that replay, which lives on a deleted scratch branch) reads as unapproved pipeline code and the babysitter escalates a false Article 4.2 CRIT to the operator - three times on 2026-09-20; the predicate resolves a recorded replay chain to a reviewed commit, bounded, and the approval writer exits non-zero on a not-approved verdict instead of printing it
